Sandy Oar by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Bursting with charm, this inviting cottage welcomes up to 12 guests with vibrant touches and classic lake house style. The colorful accents add personality throughout, and the cheerful carriage house offers even more space and comfort. Inside, the open living, dining, and kitchen areas create a warm, connected atmosphere. A plush sectional faces a smart TV with DVD player. The dining table seats six, with five more seats at the spacious kitchen island. The kitchen features granite countertops, a dual fuel range, and custom cabinetry with matching appliances—stylish and functional. The primary bedroom on the main floor offers a wrought-iron king bed and an armoire with a concealed TV/DVD.

The en-suite bath includes a large walk-in shower with bench seating and a dual vanity. Down the hall, a queen guest bedroom has a TV/DVD and shares a bathroom with a tub/shower combo. Upstairs, you’ll find another queen guest room and a bunk room with two sets of twin bunks—both with TVs/DVDs and a shared hall bath featuring a walk-in shower. Out back, the carriage house is bright and welcoming. With a queen bedroom that opens into a cozy living area and efficiency kitchen, it’s perfect for added privacy or independent guests. Additional amenities include spacious porches, plenty of outdoor seating, and a firepit for evening relaxation. The Frog Pool and other community amenities are just a short stroll away. Welcome! Our local team at Oversee 30A is here to ensure a seamless, relaxing stay. We're nearby and available daily—with a 24/7 emergency line for added peace of mind.
